name: Potentiometers and trimmers
summary: Knobs and trimmers that set a resistance: volume, speed, brightness and adjustment.
uses: Replacing worn knobs in radios and amps
identify: Knob shafts on radios, amps, dimmers, fans and tools; small blue or brass trimmers on power and DC-DC boards. Marked with a value like B10K or 103.
test: The outer pins should read the marked value, and the middle pin to one end should change smoothly as you turn it.
